name: cyber-code-vscode
description: Local VS Code integration for cyber-code

cyber-code.executable.description: Path to the cyber-code executable. Provider credentials remain managed by cyber-code.

cyber-code.runtime.description: Runtime authority used by the extension. A failed cyber-agent runtime never falls back to coding.

cyber-code.cyberAgentEndpoint.description: Optional HTTPS cyber-agent endpoint for a managed runtime.

cyber-code.cyberAgentExecutable.description: Local cyber-agent executable used when the cyber-agent runtime is selected.

scripts.test: npm run compile:test && node --test dist/client.test.js dist/runtime.test.js
